shadows.name: app-header
shadows.purpose: Separate the fixed application shell from page content.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Lift modal forms above the dimmed page.

components.name: Application Top Bar
components.description: Fixed brand strip with store and user context.
components.css: .ds-topbar { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; min-height:52px; padding:0 16px; background:#db3455; color:#fff; font:600 14px system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-topbar strong { letter-spacing:.06em; } .ds-topbar:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #212529; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Page Title Strip
components.description: Light title band beneath the fixed app bar.
components.css: .ds-titlebar { background:rgba(255,255,255,.96); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(229,231,235,.9); padding:10px 16px; } .ds-titlebar h1 { margin:0; color:#111827; font:800 clamp(1.15rem,2.2vw,1.5rem)/1.15 system-ui,sans-serif; }

components.name: Settings Primary Button
components.description: Teal primary action in the settings module.
components.css: .ds-settings-primary { min-height:40px; padding:8px 14px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:6px; background:#176c63; color:#fff; font:600 14px system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-settings-primary:hover { background:#10584f; } .ds-settings-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #212529; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Compact white field with a neutral stroke.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; color:#586474; font:600 13px system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height:40px; padding:8px 10px; border:1px solid #cbd3dc; border-radius:6px; background:#fff; color:#212529; font:400 15px system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(29,119,110,.25); border-color:#1d776e; }

components.name: Dense Data Table
components.description: Operational rows with clear column labels and separators.
components.css: .ds-table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; background:#fff; color:#273444; font:400 14px system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-table th { padding:8px 11px; background:#edf1f4; color:#465362; text-align:left; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; } .ds-table td { padding:8px 11px; border-bottom:1px solid #edf0f3; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background:#f8fafb; }

components.name: Modal Form
components.description: Focused edit surface over a dimmed page.
components.html: Edit user
components.css: .ds-dialog { width:min(480px,calc(100vw - 32px)); max-height:calc(100vh - 32px); overflow:auto; padding:22px; border:1px solid #d8dee6; border-radius:10px; background:#fff; color:#1f2937; box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(15,23,42,.22); font:400 14px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-dialog h2 { margin:0 0 16px; font-size:20px; } .ds-dialog button { min-height:40px; padding:8px 14px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:#176c63; color:#fff; font:600 14px system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-dialog button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #212529; outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: Preserve Button Rouge's existing custom operations UI: a shared magenta shell, light working surfaces, dense data views, and page-scoped accents. Avoid importing an unrelated marketing identity or claiming a unified token system that the code does not yet have.
keyCharacteristics: Mostly flat surfaces with overlay shadows

rules.name: The Scoped Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep page-local action and chart colors within their modules unless intentionally promoted to shared tokens.

rules.name: The Focus Visibility Rule
rules.body: Never remove a native focus outline without an equally visible replacement.

dos: Do preserve the magenta shared shell and task-first, information-dense page structure.
Do maintain at least 4.5:1 contrast for normal text and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't carry over the previous Notion marketing palette or page patterns.
Don't claim a unified component or token system where the implementation is page-scoped.
